title: Guided Tour & an Easier Windows Install
highlights: Take me for a tour: a short guided tour of notes, meetings, Voice Type, Teams import, profiles, the AI Workspace, and your AI and transcription choices. Start it any time from Help & about at the bottom of the sidebar, the command palette (Ctrl+K), or Settings → About. It opens by itself once on a new, empty workspace, and is available in English, French, Japanese, and Chinese.

The Windows app no longer needs the .NET Desktop Runtime installed: it carries its own, and the installer runs on the .NET Framework that is part of Windows 10 and 11. Windows shows HuskyNote's real version in Apps & features and in the file properties.
If the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is missing, HuskyNote offers to install it from Microsoft when it starts, instead of opening a blank window.
Updating while HuskyNote is running in the system tray no longer fails partway: the installer offers to close it first. Finish no longer runs the installation a second time.
Uninstalling asks first and keeps your notes, meetings and settings unless you tick the option to delete them, and it no longer opens a console window or ends with an error.

title: ChatGPT Sign-In, Teams Transcripts, Meeting Merge & a New Look
highlights: Use your ChatGPT plan for AI: choose ChatGPT (Codex) in Settings → AI. HuskyNote runs the Codex app on this computer, signed in with your ChatGPT account, so there is no API key to manage. Codex runs with its tools turned off and can only read what HuskyNote sends it. Available in the Windows app and when running HuskyNote from source.

A new look throughout the app: buttons, menus, dialogs, lists, and pages are rebuilt in a calm, Notion-style design with the Geist font, a simpler sidebar and topbar, and a Light, Dark, or System theme choice.
A redesigned landing page and refreshed HuskyNote logo and icons.

Home shows your work at a glance: meeting and note totals, open action items you can tick off, time spent in meetings, what is coming up, meetings still without a report, open questions, and recent work.
Import a meeting from a Microsoft Teams transcript (.vtt or .docx), from transcript text copied out of Teams, or from a recording, which is transcribed on this device.

Supplement a meeting's transcript with the Teams transcript: HuskyNote lines up the two by time, takes speaker names from Teams, adds lines it missed, and can have the AI correct the wording. Restore original undoes it.

The browser extension (2.1.2) can collect the whole transcript from an open Teams meeting recap, even when downloading is not allowed. It scrolls the transcript panel and reads only the text Teams shows you; the result is ready in HuskyNote's Supplement and Import dialogs.

Merge recordings that belong to one meeting into a single meeting, with the pauses between them marked. Unmerge splits them again. A recording that was interrupted can be finished from its saved audio.

Recordings no longer fail to save during long meetings, the recording timer no longer runs two to three times too fast, and if the device's storage fails mid-meeting, HuskyNote stops and saves everything captured so far.
Generate a meeting report later when none was written at the time (for example, before an AI was connected). Edit a finished meeting's title, and polish its Topics discussed with AI, with Undo.
The PDF meeting report is redesigned and now includes Key Decisions and Action Items, with completed action items ticked.

Markdown export is ready to hand to another AI: meeting details, the full report, your notes, and the complete transcript from start to finish with a timestamp on every line, plus where recording paused and which lines came from Teams.

Complete backups: Settings → Storage prepares a .huskybackup file with everything in the current profile, including audio, and restores it into a new profile. It also shows how much storage is used and whether the browser keeps it permanently.

Transcription setup is one step with download sizes and a microphone test. Filipino and Taglish language choices are fixed, recordings are saved every second with phrases queued so none are lost, and Whisper Small and Turbo are available to try, with a local accuracy benchmark.
Notes show whether changes are saved, saving, or failed, with Retry. Deleting a note can be undone, and Search and Commands now have separate buttons.
Dialogs, lists, and menus work fully with the keyboard and keep focus inside while open.
All click and interaction sounds are removed.
Checked checkboxes and pressed toggles are visible again in dark mode.

title: Profiles, GPU Transcription, Linux App & GitHub-Style Dark Mode
highlights: Profiles keep separate workspaces for different jobs or projects. Switch from the top of the sidebar; each profile has its own notes, meetings, documents, manuals, and schedule, and a new profile starts with your current AI and transcription settings.

Choose which microphone to record from with the dropdown next to Voice Type in Husky Notes and Start Microphone in meetings. The choice is remembered, shared by both, used as your mic for Google Meet or tab recordings, and falls back to the system default if that microphone is unplugged.
Resize the Notes and Meetings lists by dragging their right edge (double-click to reset), or collapse them to a thin rail. The layout is remembered.
HuskyNote for Linux: download an AppImage, or a .tar.gz that runs from any folder. It opens in its own window with Chromium, Chrome, Edge, or Brave, or in your default browser.
Press F11 in the desktop app to go full screen.
Optional update check in Settings: once a day, HuskyNote can ask GitHub whether a newer release exists and show a notice. It is off by default and sends nothing from your workspace.

Parakeet TDT v3 now runs on the GPU on computers that support it. A configuration error made it fall back to the slower CPU version every time; on an RTX 4060, phrases now transcribe about 8 times faster.
The first phrase of a recording no longer waits several seconds while the GPU warms up.
Parakeet starts without an internet connection once downloaded, because its speech runtime now ships with the app instead of loading from a CDN.
Microphone audio is filtered properly when it is converted for transcription, so hiss and high-pitched noise no longer fold into the speech range.

Settings shows which speech models are downloaded on this device and how large they are, lets you remove them, and says whether the GPU can be used, including when the browser has graphics acceleration turned off and how to turn it on.
The macOS app’s built-in server now sets the file types the speech engines need, instead of relying on the version of Python that ships with macOS to know them.
Dark mode uses GitHub's dark palette: #0d1117 pages, a #010409 sidebar and topbar, and #30363d borders. Light mode is unchanged.

Light mode now works on the Meetings recorder and meeting reports, Notes version history, Manuals, Documents, AI Workspace, Screen Recorder, Templates, and Husky Notes pages, which still showed dark panels and light text.
In dark mode, the Meetings recorder, meeting report, Manuals, Documents, AI Workspace, and Husky Notes pages use the same background as the rest of the app instead of pure black.
Cards and calendar cells in dark mode no longer have white outlines, and about 340 dark-mode borders and hover states that never displayed now work.
The meeting stats and the Report / Summary / Transcript tabs no longer collapse into thin slivers when a meeting has a long transcript or report.
Zoomed PDF pages are no longer cut off on the left side.
The workspace switcher stays in the same place on every page, its menu opens directly under it, and it matches the other topbar buttons in dark mode.
The pull-cord theme switch no longer blocks clicks on the buttons underneath it.
The Settings header now scrolls with the page instead of staying pinned to the top.
Removed the "Thock" sound button from the topbar. Cmd/Ctrl + M still mutes sound effects.

title: HuskyNote Rebrand, On-Device Transcription & Claude
highlights: Rebranded from DomoNote to HuskyNote with a new husky logo, mascot, and app icons. Notes and meetings saved by DomoNote carry over on first launch.
Meetings are transcribed on this device with Whisper, including shared tab audio mixed with your microphone. It also works in the desktop apps, where browser speech recognition is unavailable.

Choose a transcription engine in Settings: Parakeet (default, fastest, 25 European languages), Moonshine (lightweight, English), or Whisper (multilingual). Languages an engine does not support switch to Whisper automatically.
Claude is available as an AI provider with your own Anthropic API key (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, or Haiku 4.5). The key stays on this device and is left out of workspace backups.
Rebuilt macOS disk images for Universal, Apple Silicon, and Intel Macs.
Removed the glow that followed the cursor across every page.

title: Multilingual Meetings, Speaker Names & Windows App
highlights: Live transcription and AI translation across languages, with automatic spoken-language detection and summaries in the language you choose.
Speaker names are picked up automatically from Google Meet and other meeting apps, including a participant scanner that works without the Chrome extension.
An always-on-top floating meeting controller that stays visible over Google Meet and fullscreen windows.
Native Windows desktop app with a standalone installer.
Dark and light themes with the pull-cord switch and a circular transition, and the interface in English, Chinese, Japanese, and French.
One-click Chrome extension setup, uploads for PowerPoint, Word, and text files, and document deletion.
A responsive landing page with a mobile menu, automated build pipelines, and reliable installer downloads.

title: Interactive Audio ("Thock"), Workspace Modes & Husky Mascot
highlights: Web Audio API mechanical switch audio synthesis with custom low-frequency thock, click, pop, and chime.
Workspace Modes: Husky Notes Focus Sanctuary, Automated Schedule & Calendar, Full Screen Studio Recorder.
Animated Husky mascot companion taking notes in Husky Notes mode.
Embedded screen recording walkthrough demo player in About section.
Collapsible desktop sidebar (256px <-> 64px) with persistent hardware status pill.
Screen capture flight recorder with keyframe step extraction.

title: Initial Production Release — HuskyNote Core Architecture
highlights: Local-first client-side architecture using Dexie IndexedDB.
Meeting Secretary with real browser MediaRecorder speech recognition and clickable timeline milestones.
Document Intelligence powered by PDF.js with coordinate-anchored annotations and Turn into Steps.
Direct local integration with Ollama models on port 11434 with 100% private execution.
Automated single-click Ollama setup script (setup-ollama.sh and start.sh).
Client-side PDF and Markdown export engines.
